feasibility_reasoning: The split-behaviour fix is correct. scripts/lib/routeCodeSplitting.ts:28-34 returns undefined, which falls back to the default groupings (router-code-splitter-plugin.js:79, constants.js). Returning [["component"]] keeps HomeErrorComponent and HomeNotFoundComponent (index.tsx:80-97) in the shell for about 2.8 KB of source; errorCopy is already in the entry. The test at routeCodeSplitting.test.ts:21-26 pins '/' to undefined and must be updated. FooterSlideup parity also holds: it renders null on SSR and on the first client render (FooterSlideup.tsx:64), and the idle import gets its own small chunk in both prototype builds (chunk-inventory-proto1.json: FooterSlideup-7aHMjohj.js). Three things weaken the change: (1) plain React.lazy for LatestPostsHome and Footnotes conflicts with the repo's documented streaming-SSR rule (lazyWidgets.tsx:49-56; docs/performance/2026-10-01-first-visit-lcp-streaming.md:9-27): on the first render per process, lazy suspends, the shell ships the HomeLoadingNotice fallback, and the real HTML (including the latest_posts LCP card) arrives at the end of the document via $RC; the repo's fix is server-eager loading via createIsomorphicFn (lazyWidgets.tsx:151-162); (2) the LatestPostsHome chunk is no longer preloaded, so any urgent re-render of Index (index.tsx:347-356) before it arrives makes React drop the server HTML and show the skeleton, which is the F6 CLS class in latest_posts mode; Footnotes has no Suspense of its own (HomeBuilderContent.tsx:68-72); (3) at minChunkSize 2048 (vite.config.ts:312) the prototype moved date-fns into admin.analytics, which the entry then imports statically (+4.2 KB gz in boot), and check:entry-purity does not catch it, so C1 must ship together with C10 and C9. The prototype also has a bug: IdleFooterSlideup renders itself instead of FooterSlideup (prototype.diff), so FooterSlideup never mounted; the Footnotes part was never prototyped.
blocking_issues: LatestPostsHome/Footnotes must use createIsomorphicFn (server-eager, client-lazy) instead of plain React.lazy; otherwise latest_posts mode ships a skeleton shell plus an end-of-document $RC swap (LCP and CLS regression, replayed by the edge cache), as documented in lazyWidgets.tsx:49-56

Hydration-discard hazard: after C1 the LatestPostsHome chunk is not preloaded; add a conditional modulepreload or a client import kick-off when the loader resolves homeMode==='latest_posts'; give Footnotes its own Suspense boundary
Hard dependency on C10 (and C9): at experimentalMinChunkSize 2048 the change puts admin.analytics (date-fns) into the entry's static imports, +4.2 KB gz boot (proto1), and no existing gate catches it

effect_reasoning: The pre-FCP part was measured with the canonical harness (h2, fixture, A/B interleaved, 3+3 mobile). The transform verdicts/boot-js-C1/drop-route-preloads.mjs removes the head and Link modulepreloads of exactly the chunks C1 removes (blog.index, Footnotes, PaginatedPostGrid, useInFeedAds, eventInvoiceMath). In all B runs those chunks moved after observed FCP: 25 files / 506.4 KB -> 20 / 500.2 KB pre-oFCP, highBeforeLcpImg 618.3 -> 612.2 KB. FCP went 4.07 -> 4.08 s, LCP 4.82 -> 4.83 s, SI 4.07 -> 4.08 s, which is zero within the ±0.01 s A/A noise; the TBT delta (+90 ms) is noise (range 213-398). In production the removed pre-FCP set is about 5.6-7 KB; at about 5 ms/KB that is at most 35 ms, worth about 0.09 pt (FCP) + 0.12 pt (LCP) + 0.04 pt (SI) ≈ 0.25 pt, and the +4.2 KB admin.analytics regression without C10 cancels most of it. The claimed TBT/SI -20..-50 ms is not supported. Production mobile TBT is 202 ms: gtag AW 133 + G- 20 + hydration 49, with TTI 10.6 s set by gtag. None of the removed chunks (cfp-submit, vendor-lucide, PostListCard, ArchivePagination, MoneyText, author._slug) appear in bootup-time (50 ms threshold) or long-tasks, in production or in 8 local mobile runs; the one exception is author._slug once at 71 ms with 0 scripting. Their evaluation (about 160 KB raw, roughly 20-40 ms at 4x) runs as a separate module-graph task because of the setTimeout(0) before hydrate, and a task under 50 ms adds 0 to TBT. Render work in builder mode is unchanged: FooterSlideup renders null, LatestPostsHome is not rendered, and there are no footnotes. The post-boot wave starts after observed LCP (3374 vs 3303 ms), so SI is about 0. On the mobile TBT curve (p10 200, median 600, σ 0.857) near TBT 250-400, the slope is about 0.001/ms × 0.30 weight, i.e. about 1 pt per 30 ms, so 0..-15 ms of TBT is 0..+0.5 pt. Desktop TBT is 0 in production and 50-71 ms locally (score about 0.99), so 0 pt. The FooterSlideup/blog.index part of the closure (cfp-submit, vendor-lucide, MoneyText, author._slug, date-fns pl) exists only because the min-size merge put FooterSlideup into blog.index-BPS41JJU.js (reports/chunk-inventory.json), so C10 alone most likely removes it (inferred, not built), and C2 drops the errorComponent preload without route code changes.
corrected_estimate: Mobile: FCP/LCP/SI 0 s measured (±0.01 s), theoretical at most -35 ms (≈ +0.25 pt); TBT 0..-15 ms (expected about -5) -> 0..+0.5 pt; total about 0..+0.5 pt. Desktop: 0 pt. Without C10: net about 0 or slightly negative (+4.2 KB gz render-blocking boot). Real value: hygiene and real-user hydration (the '/' component graph goes from 3-4 import levels to about 2, so hydration starts 1-2 RTT earlier, with about 12 fewer High requests in the hydration window). It is not a lever for the 85/95 targets.
better_alternative: Ship C10 first: with minChunkSize 0 or a closure-safe merge, FooterSlideup becomes its own shared chunk, which most likely removes the blog.index inheritance (cfp-submit, vendor-lucide, MoneyText, author._slug, date-fns) without any React change. Use C2 (preload filter) to drop the errorComponent/eventInvoiceMath preload. Keep from C1 only the split fix ([["component"]]) and, if wanted, the server-eager/client-lazy LatestPostsHome and Footnotes via createIsomorphicFn, with a conditional preload for latest_posts mode.
